name: The Ojai Jacket in French Blue Moleskin
description: The Ojai Jacket in French Blue Moleskin from Taylor Stitch 14.5-oz. 100% organic cotton moleskin. Single chest pocket with pen slot. Two lower patch pockets feature top and side entry. All pockets bar-tacked at stress points. Double-needle felled construction. Ring-back buttons with metal pins and rings. Wash cold and tumble dry low. Made in China.

name: The Slub Tee in Smoked Olive
description: The Slub Tee in Smoked Olive from Taylor Stitch 5.5-oz. 100% organic cotton slub jersey. Garment dyed and washed for a soft, lived in feel. Single chest pocket. Rib on neck opening. Fully taped shoulder seam. Wash cold and tumble dry low. Made in China.

name: The Slub Tee in White
description: The Slub Tee in White from Taylor Stitch 5.5-oz. 100% organic cotton slub jersey. Garment dyed and washed for a soft, lived in feel. Single chest pocket. Rib on neck opening. Fully taped shoulder seam. Wash cold and tumble dry low. Made in China.

name: The Utility Shirt in Brick Sashiko
description: The Utility Shirt in Brick Sashiko from Taylor Stitch 8.5-oz. 100% organic cotton sashiko. Washed for a soft, lived in feel. Dual button-through chest pockets. Left pocket features a pen slot. Two back pleats for ease of movement. Double-needle felled construction. Wash cold and tumble dry low. Made in China.

name: The Jackson Jacket in Rinsed Indigo French Terry Stripe
description: The Jackson Jacket in Rinsed Indigo French Terry Stripe from Taylor Stitch 14-oz. 100% organic cotton French terry stripe. 6-oz. 65% polyester, 35% cotton twill locker loop, under cuffs and pocket flaps. Unlined. Four patch pockets with snap flap closure. Bottom pockets feature side entry. Single interior pocket nested under the left top patch pocket. Button closure. Double-needle felled construction. Wash cold and tumble dry low. Made in China.

name: The Rugby Shirt in Ivy
description: The Rugby Shirt in Ivy from Taylor Stitch 12-oz. 100% organic cotton knit jersey body. 8-oz. 100% organic cotton twill collar. 14-oz. 100% organic cotton rib cuff. Washed for a soft, lived in feel. Three button half placket with collar stand. Rubber rugby buttons. Natural twill tape detailing on neck. Wash cold and tumble dry low. Made in China.

name: The Chatham Crew in Marine Stripe Jacquard
description: The Chatham Crew in Marine Stripe Jacquard from Taylor Stitch 100% organic cotton 3 gauge yarns. Diamond jacquard knit throughout body and sleeves. 1x1 melange rib construction on collar, sleeve cuffs and hem with solid navy border. Hand wash cold, reshape and lay flat to dry. Made in Vietnam.

name: The Roper Jacket in Vintage Wash Organic Selvedge
description: The Roper Jacket in Vintage Wash Organic Selvedge from Taylor Stitch 14-oz. 100% organic cotton selvedge denim. Unlined. Bleach washed for vintage look and feel with some distressing at the hem and sleeve cuff. Single pleated front. Dual button through chest pockets. The left pocket features a button hole pen sleeve. Two lower angled welt pockets. Zig-zag reinforcement stitching on under collar. Adjustable back tabs. YKK two way separating zipper. Double-needle topstitch throughout. Wash cold and tumble dry low. Made in Vietnam.

name: The Rugby Shirt in Coal
description: The Rugby Shirt in Coal from Taylor Stitch 12-oz. 100% organic cotton knit jersey body. 8-oz. 100% organic cotton twill collar. 14-oz. 100% organic cotton rib cuff. Washed for a soft, lived-in feel. Three-button half placket with collar stand. Rubber rugby buttons. Natural twill tape detailing on neck. Wash cold and tumble dry low. Made in China.
